contract: DESCRIPTIVE COMPS, DISPLAY ONLY. These are historical strata, not a projection and not a correction to any grade. Never a model input, a rank, or a sort key. The sweep that produced them returned NO SHIP under nested cross-validation.

source.producer_status: ABSENT from the tree. Nothing in the repo writes archetype_descriptive_hit.json, so mean_war, median_war, bust_rate and the oof_resid_* columns cannot be regenerated or independently audited. They are a frozen quote of a 2026-07-25 measurement.
source.reproduced: Stratum MEMBERSHIP is reproducible and is re-checked on every run: all 3,957 ids and all 3,957 resolved-row counts match the pre-registered outcome-blind enumeration exactly.
source.model_verdict: NO SHIP. Nested CV found no out-of-sample value: hitter-side rank-correlation deltas run -0.0106 to +0.0082 with no CI clean of zero, and 45 to 141 percent of the in-fold selected effect is selection bias (inner 0.86 to 1.85 WAR collapsing to -0.60 to +0.50 out of fold). Negative-control arms invert. Evidence: tools/_comb_out/nested_hit_*.json.
source.dropped_field: The source health_warning is not propagated. It is false; see audit.health_warning_verdict.

population.description: hitters with a MiLB track record, decision_year 2016-2024
population.resolved_floor: n_resolved >= 40 (the sweep's pre-registered stratum size floor)
population.note: n_resolved counts rows carrying an out-of-fold residual; n_complete counts the subset whose 6-year WAR window has actually closed. Every WAR and bust number below is computed on n_complete only.

base.bust_definition: career WAR at or below 0.5 in the complete window
base.note: population baseline; a stratum is only interesting against this, and its own CI has to clear it

reliability.basis: oof_resid_t, the Welch t of the stratum's mean out-of-fold eFV residual against its complement

legend.priced: Out-of-fold residual against the shipped eFV model is indistinguishable from zero (|t| under 1.645). The comp shelf and the grade tell the same story; show the comps plainly.
legend.watch: |t| at or above 1.645 but not surviving Benjamini-Hochberg at q = 0.05 across all 3,957 strata. Nominally off-model, well inside what 3,957 overlapping tests throw off by chance. Treat as unverified, not as a finding.
legend.off_model: Survives Benjamini-Hochberg at q = 0.05 across all 3,957 strata (|t| at or above 3.30 here). The stratum's members were systematically mis-graded out of fold, so the comp shelf and the eFV grade DISAGREE. Neither is authoritative: the sweep that found these returned NO SHIP under nested CV, so this is a flag on the display, not a correction to the grade. Mark it in the UI. Read audit.off_model_shape before reading any of these as a model defect: the tier is almost entirely the floored corner of the outcome scale.

reliability.zero_var_note: war_lo95 == war_hi95 == mean_war. Every complete-window member of the stratum realized the same WAR, in practice 0.0 because none of them reached the majors. The interval is degenerate, not precise: it carries no information about how a future player in the stratum will do. Never render it as a tight confidence band.
reliability.ui_rule: rel == 2 must be visibly marked (the comp shelf and the grade disagree). thin == 1 should carry the sample size next to the number. zero_var == 1 must suppress the interval entirely rather than draw a zero-width band.

off_model_shape.reading: 76 of 77 surviving strata carry a NEGATIVE residual, i.e. the model graded them above what they realized, and 43 busted at a 100 percent rate with 29 of them showing a zero-width WAR interval. The tier is dominated by the floor of the outcome scale: WAR cannot go below roughly zero for a player who never debuts, so any model that assigns a positive expectation to a young low-FV group is guaranteed a one-sided residual there. Treat off_model as 'the comp shelf bottoms out where the grade does not', not as evidence of a correctable eFV defect. It is a display caveat only, and the nested-CV NO SHIP verdict stands over all of it.

audit.health_warning_verdict: FALSE. The source health_warning claims every stratum's out-of-fold residual is statistically zero; 477 of 3957 strata sit at |t| >= 2 (expected about 180 under a true global null), 77 survive Benjamini-Hochberg at q = 0.05, and the artifact's own already_priced flag is False on 474 rows. Not propagated.

age.label: Age at decision
age.note: 20 / 22 / 23.5, the HS-signing, college-draft and old-for-the-upper-minors conventions

age_rel_level.label: Age vs level
age_rel_level.note: years above or below the level's typical age

levels.VYNG: Very young for level (2+ years young)

level.label: Level at decision
level.note: the level ladder; DSL is folded into CPX for sample size

bonus.label: Signing bonus
bonus.note: terciles among rows that report a bonus

tercile_edges_note: frozen, outcome-blind cut points from the pre-registration; a panel must bucket a live player with THESE numbers to land in the same strata. Values are level-relative rate differences on the eFV matrix scale, not percentages.

cols_note.f: indices into tokens; length is the way of the stratum (1 to 3)
cols_note.n_resolved: rows in the stratum carrying an out-of-fold residual
cols_note.n_complete: subset whose WAR window has closed; EVERY war and bust number below is computed on this subset only
cols_note.mean_war: mean realized WAR of the n_complete members
cols_note.war_hi95: upper bound; see reliability.zero_var_note when they are equal
cols_note.median_war: median realized WAR; far below mean_war in most strata because the distribution is a mass at zero plus a tail
cols_note.bust_rate: share of n_complete at or below 0.5 career WAR
cols_note.resid: mean out-of-fold residual, realized minus the shipped eFV blend prediction, on the sweep's calibrated WAR scale (arm R_cal). Negative means the model graded the stratum above what it realized. Diagnostic for the reliability flag only; it is NOT an offset anyone may apply to a grade.
cols_note.resid_t: Welch t of resid against the stratum's complement

row_note: A player matches a row when every token in f is in the player's own facet set. Bucket the player with facets[].edges and tercile_edges, which are the frozen cut points the sweep itself used.
